decisions.reason: Although framed as a test series and therefore somewhat easier to discontinue, it extends the firm's core physical-media niche and the multi-title launch creates enough visible commitment that management would likely give it more time unless clear failure appears.

As a compilation series closely aligned with the firm's established catalog strengths, it likely reflects higher curation and reputational investment, so management would be inclined to continue it and justify the launch rather than exit quickly.
